correctness.rationale: Actual finite Fano incidence matching complex has 21 graph edges and exactly (21,168,644,1218,1050,336,24) faces. The package computes F2 boundary ranks (20,148,496,722,312,24); the rational ranks match because the F2 values are lower bounds and the chain-complex dimension upper bounds force equality, proving sole reduced H4 of rank16. Independent enumeration reproduced all 3461 faces and 336 graph automorphisms. The signed simplex Lefschetz character and separate edge-orbit inclusion/exclusion computation agree on all 336; character types preserve: (1,16),(2,0),(3,1),(4,0),(7,2), exchange: (2,4),(6,1),(8,0). Sylow-7 eight-point permutation character minus trivial gives irreducible 7d module; the residual 8d character has self-inner product one and zero cross inner products, yielding rational 1⊕7⊕8.
